hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')).tool_input?.file_path;if(!p)process.exit(0);if(!/\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json)$/i.test(p))process.exit(0);try{const f=fs.readFileSync(process.cwd()+'/'+p,'utf8');const lines=f.split('\n').filter(l=>l.trim().startsWith('console.log'));if(lines.length)console.error('\u26a0\ufe0f [ecc] console.log in '+p+' ('+lines.length+' line(s)) — remove before commit')}catch(e){}"
